study: Independent V7 implementation comparison after an explicit wait-budget fix and preregistration; no resumed V6 request.
change_from_v6: Only call_timeout_seconds=600 and scheduling seed=1. Seed 1 was chosen before model calls to exercise generation before the fixed arm search. No selection on measured scores.
generation: Random and failure each receive exactly three scheduled generation attempts with gpt-6-astra low. Retain every acceptance, rejection and incomplete attempt. No outcome-triggered extra attempts.

budget.actual_http_attempts_tokens_and_dollars: Not bounded by logical turns. Report observed native usage and unknowns separately.

partitions: Same authored train 2 / validation 1 / test 2 as V5 and V6. Native reference and negative calibration precedes all model calls. These final test model results have never been observed.
final_test: Open only after all arm selections are frozen. Retain every baseline/arm, mark comparisons ineligible if any learning pool, formal search or complete score is missing.
infrastructure_failure: Stop on terminal failure or unknown turn. Inspect original native turn without resubmission. Do not automatically restart the study or launch further independent studies on failure.
analysis: Descriptive results on two authored held-out compound tasks: generation acceptance, prompt constraints, formal training gate, repair/regression where remeasured, held-out differences and per-phase native cost. Negative results are valid; no population-level significance claim.
selection_bias: All V2-V6 and component probes remain reported. This configuration reflects observed implementation failures, not a confirmatory replication. V6 timeout does not prove rate limiting; waiting longer does not ensure availability.
